blocks.x: One of the best music venues in NYC is located in the Theater District just steps from Times Square. Sony Hall is a multi-genre live music venue where both locals and visitors can see their favorite acts, catch sensational tributes and party on the weekend, all set in the basement of the Paramount Hotel.
And this year, Candlelight illuminates Sony Hall, bringing unrivaled concerts for every music lover. This season, you can catch classical tributes to neo-soul favorites, Frank Sinatra, and more.

Originally operating as the Diamond Horseshoe, this venue was a staple of New York’s vaudeville era. It was a lively hot spot where patrons could dine, dance, and enjoy live music alongside burlesque shows. Tucked away in the basement of the Paramount Hotel, the space features striking Art Deco and Baroque details that helped secure its designation as an official New York City landmark in 2009. Today, under the management of Blue Note Entertainment Group, the space balances cutting-edge Sony sound technology with its timeless, high-glam aesthetic.

Open daily, there is always something going on at Sony Hall. Whether it’s a groovy jazz concert like The Jazz Room, an electric house music party hosted by renowned DJs or a private event, Sony Hall is a versatile space that caters to any event. It is that versatile that it regularly welcomes Candlelight concerts that pay tribute to some of the biggest names in music. The venue transforms into an intimate space where thousands of candles flicker and sway to beloved melodies.
For refreshing drinks and delicious bites, visit the Sony Hall Bar & Cafe, open Sunday to Thursday from 7:00 am to 2:00 am, and Friday and Sunday till 4:00 am.
Candlelight Jazz: Tribute to Frank Sinatra
Candlelight: The Best of Hans Zimmer
Candlelight: Neo-Soul Favorites ft. Songs by Prince, Childish Gambino, & More
Where is Sony Hall and how to get there?

Sony Hall is a two-minute walk from Times Square, located on 235 West 46th Str inside the Paramount Hotel. The nearest major station is 50 St, three minutes away from Penn Station via the 1 line. There is also a direct bus line from the said station but there are also multiple parking garages nearby for those driving.
What is the venue capacity of Sony Hall?
The venue can accommodate up to 500 seated guests and 1,000 standing.
Is there a dress code at Sony Hall?
There is no strict dress code for most of the events but rules can change for private functions.
Yes, VIP Seating is offered for most shows, which includes the best tables in the house for seated shows or the only seating in the wings for standing shows.
Given its location in the Theater District, many famous nearby venues are theaters, including Lyric Theatre, St. James Theatre, Walter Kerr Theatre, and Eugene O’Neill Theatre.

If you’re spending the day in the city center, do check out the venue’s broad program for an unforgettable entertainment experience. And if you want to see more Candlelight venues in the city, click here to see this season’s spaces.
